search_closure.reason: The prospectively declared MICA/cassowary/Norway shortlist is exhausted and the candidate funnel already contains 25 protocol-integrity STOPs. Continuing until a third score appears would convert a bounded replication programme into open-ended data-availability hunting.

claim_boundary.supported_statement: A label-invariant summary of surviving accessibility-compatible worlds contained non-redundant heldout predictive information beyond the same strong conventional learner in two genuinely fresh heterogeneous observation systems.

publication_route.nature_ecology_and_evolution_reason: No valid third favorable predictive endpoint was obtained under the frozen endpoint-3 programme.
publication_route.fallback_condition: Use Ecography only if the final manuscript is primarily biogeographic/spatiotemporal rather than methodological.
